controlifychords.binding.key.desc: A dedicated key for chords. Bind it to a controller button in Controlify, then reference it in the chord config.
controlifychords.config.title: Controlify Chords
controlifychords.config.help: Modifier list: hold them all. If the same key set is configured in more than one order (e.g. LB+RB and RB+LB), those chords are automatically distinguished by press order; with a single order, order does not matter. Trigger list: tapping any one runs the same action. Releasing any modifier cancels; the action runs when the trigger is released.
controlifychords.config.name: Display name
controlifychords.config.modifiers.tip: Keys you keep held down. Examples: controlify:button/dpad_up, controlify:button/left_shoulder. Physical buttons keep their normal function.
controlifychords.config.triggers.tip: Keys you tap once. Examples: controlify:button/south, controlify:button/north. Must be released within 8 ticks.
controlifychords.config.action_value.tip: KEY_MAPPING: a key name such as key.swapOffhand. COMMAND: e.g. /spawn. CUSTOM: a registered action id.
controlifychords.binding.open_config.des: Bind any controller button to this in Controlify; pressing it opens the chord config.
